rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for abstract elements, events, or systems that are tightly linked together.

example.english: These policies are interlocking, so changing one will affect the whole system.
example.traditional: 呢幾個政策環環相扣，改一樣就會影響成套制度。
example.jyutping: ne1 gei2 go3 zing3 caak3 waan4 waan4 soeng1 kau3 goi2 jat1 joeng6 zau6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 sing4 tou3 zai3 dou6

rows.note: Use this for physical objects that are fastened or locked into one another.

example.english: These two fasteners are interlocking, so they will not come apart no matter how hard you pull.
example.traditional: 呢兩個扣件互相扣住，點拉都唔會甩。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 kau3 gin6 wu6 soeng1 kau3 zyu6 dim2 laai1 dou1 m4 wui5 lat1

rows.note: Use this specifically for mechanical parts, gears, or other pieces that fit together by meshing.

example.english: The gears need to be interlocking for the machine to run smoothly.
example.traditional: 啲齒輪要互相咬合，部機先轉得順。
example.jyutping: di1 ci2 leon4 jiu3 wu6 soeng1 ngaau5 hap6 bou6 gei1 sin1 zyun2 dak1 seon6
